requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL provide a direct CLI surface for listing and invoking the same tools exposed by MCP stdio.

case.then: The command SHALL print machine-readable JSON describing available MCP tools

case.given: A user has a repo database selected by work-dir storage options
case.when: The user runs `cozo-wiki call semantic_search --query SampleService`
case.then: The command SHALL invoke the same implementation as the MCP semantic_search tool and print JSON output

case.given: A user passes `--work-dir` pointing at a real local repository
case.then: The command SHALL use the sqlite database under `<work-dir>/.cozo-wiki/cozo-wiki.db` unless `--db` overrides it
